title: Iran Vows 'More Painful' Retaliation Against Foes While Promising Domestic Economic Relief
snippet: Tehran officials warned that future military responses will be significantly harsher while pledging to address the country's mounting economic pressures.
content:
Iranian leadership signaled a dual-track approach on Tuesday, promising to confront domestic economic struggles while simultaneously issuing a stark warning to foreign adversaries that any further military actions against the nation would draw a far severe response.

Focusing on Domestic Economy

Addressing the press, officials acknowledged the growing strain on ordinary citizens caused by persistent inflation, currency devaluation, and international sanctions. Government leaders outlined plans aimed at stabilizing key sectors of the economy, promising targeted interventions to alleviate rising living costs and boost trade despite ongoing diplomatic isolation.

Rising Regional Tensions

Alongside promises of economic reform, defense representatives delivered a fiery warning directed at regional and Western rivals. Iranian officials cautioned that any future provocations or military strikes would be met with a response described as far 'more painful' than previous engagements, signaling that Tehran remains prepared to escalate if its national sovereignty is threatened.
